description: Stream Deck Mini layout for the Goatmire 2026 on-stage demo. Six keys: slide nav + four MP4 fallbacks for Scenarios 1-4. Import via the Stream Deck app (Profile -> Import).
notes: MP4 files in priv/obs/ are produced during rehearsal Phase 3 (OBS Studio recording).

The fallbacks are recordings. If one is played on stage, say so out loud before it starts — a recording presented as a live run is a lie about the demo, and this deck makes that mistake one keypress away.
Stream Deck firmware expects PNG icons; the Stream Deck app substitutes glyphs from the title text when an icon is missing.
